ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   B. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   D. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Twahara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
